dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

title:
An individually-configurable piece of a component's data specification. This abstract type should be mixed in and
the resulting type should be used as the value type in a field on type that mixes in {@link UiSdlComponentDataSpec},
which is also abstract.

@see UiSdlComponentDataSpec
name: UiSdlComponentDataSpecSetting
